ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: RUT — Desert Fixtures
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
`RUT_WindowAdobe` — a real, player-buildable, stuffable wall-slot window (`ParentName="Wall"`, `isWall="true"`), filed against `structure_procedural_spec.md` section 9: the only wall-slot window defs in the 593-mod stack (`MUS_SpaceBase_Window`, `AM_Wall_Atlas_Glass`) are both decorative/ruin scatter with no `designationCategory` — neither is player-buildable. Every pre-industrial desert dwelling, homestead, trading post and pen keeper's house needs a window that reads adobe rather than Empire glass or spacer paneling. Stuff categories are vanilla's own (`Stony`, `Metallic`) per the owner's ruling that per-faction stuffs are not this pass's call to make. Single non-linked texture (`Graphic_Single`) rather than a full linked-wall atlas — a deliberate art-scope cut; it does not blend edges with neighboring window tiles the way `Wall` blends with itself, which is fine for a one-per-wall-run fixture. `blockLight` is set `false` (the spec leaves light-passing to the artist) so this is a functionally real window, not a window in name only like its two forerunners.
RimUtinni tier (campaign-specific) per `NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`.
